notes: Media days. In week 1 a reporter asks what this team is going to do. Promise an undefeated regular season, the conference, a top-10 finish, a win total, a winning season or a rivalry win: fans and media love it now, the AD winces, and in December you either cash the boosters' check or they replay the clip and your seat heats up. Coach reputation now regresses toward what your program is: a 4-8 year at a bottom-tier school no longer builds a 90 rep.
